g.text: LEFT LEG, VIEW ALONG THE KNEE AXIS
LINE OF ACTION AT 0° AND AT 110°
KNEE CRANK, SEEN ALONG THE AXIS
DESIGN NOTE 1: STATIC KNEE TORQUE IN A 90 DEGREE SQUAT
1. Weight above the knees: 163 kg x 9.81 = 1599 N
2. Lever from knee axis to the weight line: 184 mm
3. Torque, both knees: 1599 N x 0.184 m = 293 N m
5. Actuator moment arm at 90 degrees flexion (from the modelled pivots): 59 mm
6. Moment arm across the range: 40.0 mm at 0, 61.5 mm at 30, 69.8 mm at 55, 59.5 mm at 90, 40.3 mm at 110 degrees
7. Actuator stroke for 0 to 110 degrees: 115 mm
8. Force per knee: 147 / 0.059 = 2.5 kN, 1.2 kN per actuator
Static load is a small fraction of what a 30 mm planetary roller screw carries (about 12 kN continuous). The margin is for
dynamics: a landing or a single-leg push-off multiplies this several times for a fraction of a second.
RESULT 147 N m PER KNEE, 1.2 kN PER ACTUATOR
1. ARMOUR, ITS CARRIERS AND GUARDS ARE OMITTED.
THEIR OUTLINE IS SHOWN IN PHANTOM.
2. VIEWS ARE ALONG AND SQUARE TO THE KNEE AXIS:
3. HIDDEN LINES SHOW RODS, PINS AND THE KNEE SHAFT.
4. LEFT LEG SHOWN. THE RIGHT LEG IS OPPOSITE HAND.
